verses.english: “Mendicants, these five dwell in a charnel ground.

verses.pali: Mandattā momūhattā sosāniko hoti …pe… idamatthitaṁyeva nissāya sosāniko hoti.
verses.english: One may dwell in a charnel ground because of stupidity … corrupt wishes … madness … because it is praised by the Buddhas … or for the sake of having few wishes …
These are the five who dwell in a charnel ground.”
